# ARA by Shanaya

> ARA by Shanaya is a contemporary luxury Indian fashion brand and boutique from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It designs luxury Indian resort wear, designer evening dresses, kaftans, gowns, cocktail dresses and co-ord sets — many featuring traditional Marodi hand embroidery and zardozi embellishment in modern silhouettes. Ideal for destination weddings, receptions, vacations and trousseau. Sold online at arabyshanaya.com with shipping across India (free over ₹3,000) and worldwide. The current season is "Life's a Beach" SS '26, with collections named Dark Cloud, Horizon, Ocean, Beach, Waves, Pink Skies and Orange Vista.

Key facts:
- Type: Women's designer clothing brand / boutique
- Specialties: luxury Indian resort wear, destination wedding outfits, designer kaftans and co-ord sets, indo-western evening wear, cocktail dresses with hand embroidery, Marodi and zardozi heritage craftsmanship, trousseau wear
- Location: Thaltej, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Website: https://arabyshanaya.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/arabyshanaya
- WhatsApp: +91 89800 08826
- Payments: UPI, cards, net banking (Razorpay)
- Price range: premium (₹₹₹)
- Features: AI virtual try-on for every dress, worldwide shipping
